setting_page.title: Member Level Settings
setting_page.description: Members are graded automatically by their spending, with the matching discount and benefits applied.

master.title: Enable Member Levels
master.description: Once enabled, members are graded automatically by their spending and receive each level's discount and benefits. While disabled, every member is treated as a general member.

text.recalculate_note: Updating takes a while; it does not take effect instantly.

text.levels_note: Four levels are provided; you can edit their content or disable them

text.lead: Disable member levels? The following takes effect immediately:

effect.all_members_base: Every member is treated as a general member; members holding a level lose it
effect.discount_stops: Level discounts are no longer applied
effect.benefits_stop: Birthday coupons and upgrade bonus points are no longer issued
effect.issued_unaffected: Coupons and points already issued are unaffected

text.footnote: Re-enabling grades members again based on their spending at that time.

effect.members_regraded: Members on this level are regraded by threshold (most drop to the next level or to general member)
effect.discount_stops: This level's discount and benefits stop applying
effect.issued_unaffected: Coupons and points already issued are unaffected

text.footnote: You can re-enable it at any time.

text.spent_note: Spending is the paid total between {start} and {end}, taken when levels were last recalculated; newer orders count only after the next recalculation. It differs from the lifetime "Total Spending" on the member list. Total paid orders is a lifetime count, so the two cover different ranges and must not be divided by each other.
text.spent_note_unlimited: Spending is the paid total up to {end}, taken when levels were last recalculated; newer orders count only after the next recalculation. Total paid orders is a lifetime count, so the two cover different ranges and must not be divided by each other.
text.spent_note_undated: Spending is the paid total within the calculation period, taken when levels were last recalculated; newer orders count only after the next recalculation. Total paid orders is a lifetime count, so the two cover different ranges and must not be divided by each other.
text.footnote: Member levels are decided automatically by spending and cannot be assigned manually.

threshold.between: The threshold must be greater than {lower} and less than {upper}
threshold.greater_than: The threshold must be greater than {lower}

birthday_coupon_amount.positive: The coupon value must be greater than 0

upgrade_points.range: Enter a whole number between {minimum} and {maximum}

description.threshold: Members whose spending in the calculation period reaches this amount belong to this level.
description.base_threshold: General member is the base level; its threshold is fixed at 0 and covers everyone below the other thresholds.
description.discount_rate: Enter a rate between 0.01 and 1, e.g. 0.98 = pay 98%, 0.9 = pay 90%, 1 = no discount.

text.benefit_off: Disabled - enable it to configure the parameters
text.birthday_coupon_note: Issued once a year; every member can claim it each birthday.
text.upgrade_points_note: Issued only the first time a member reaches this level; downgrading and returning does not issue it again.
